summary: P1C-R01 and P1C-R02 resolved at the exact requested commit. No material new critical/high/medium defects or correction scope drift. Existing root merged validation, Linux execution and Phase 1 gate remain pending.

reviewer.scope: Correction delta against 845255 plus the prior full independent review; retained broad runtime evidence inspected, no broad runtime rerun.

identity.startup_suite_diff_from_accepted: Exactly eight added marker/spacing lines; no assertion changes.

prior_findings.change: Implicit qualification requires an unfiltered root/full invocation. Ordinary keyword, marker and deselect selections opt out; an explicit profile always qualifies.
prior_findings.independent_result: On both interpreters and in base/mandatory: root -k executes the actual MPC test and exits 0; ordinary root -m integration collects nine tests and --deselect collection exits 0. File-focused keyword execution passes one test and the whole MPC file passes three. Explicit-profile counterparts reject omissions. Unfiltered root and no-positional-argument default retain mandatory preflight and full inventory.
prior_findings.acceptance_preserved: Every existing profile enforcement method except __init__ has identical AST to 845255; runtime inventory, prerequisites, named allowances, exclusions, skips and xfail/xpass checks retain their original implementations.

prior_findings.change: Captured ty_status is passed to the exact embedded checker. Status 0 requires verified clean output; status 1 requires a recognized positive summary matching parsed diagnostics, then the retained owned-file allowance check.
prior_findings.independent_result: Both interpreters: actual clean ty exits 0 and its checker replay exits 0; actual full repository ty exits 1 with 404 classified diagnostics, byte-identical to retained baseline, and its checker replay exits 0. An actual new-owned diagnostic, actual tool failure, wrong statuses, absent/unrecognized output, absent diagnostics, summary count mismatch and injected unexpected owned diagnostic all fail the checker.
prior_findings.acceptance_preserved: The 404 diagnostics remain accepted assigned triage, not a zero-error gate. No new suppression, dependency change or baseline relabeling.

verification.execution: All shell commands use /bin/zsh -lc. Reused all four existing environments with uv run --no-sync or their existing executables; no installs. Pytest cache disabled, bytecode disabled, offline/CPU environment and basetemp under reviewer scratch. Runtime suites not rerun.

JUnit counts and artifact hashes verified against exact candidate source hashes.
retained_evidence.runtime: Retained actual 845255 executions: 48 passed per interpreter, no skips/failures/errors. All original fields equal parent evidence; source_commit=845255 and retained_without_rerun=true. Both log/JUnit hashes and all 48 JUnit cases verified. Startup result evidence unchanged. No runtime execution claimed by this reviewer.
retained_evidence.acceptance_boundary: Explicit profiles still qualify regardless of selection. All eight other profile methods have identical AST to 845255. Accepted 213b runtime tree and three startup helpers are identical; startup suite has only its already-reviewed eight added marker/spacing lines. Accepted 730470 package records remain identical after the two already-reviewed test-base metadata arrays are removed.
